contribution.procedure: Director contribution-tagging procedure, adopted for Project Uppercut by Director override 2026-08-02 (see docs/decisions/0006).

title: Move
description: Rule 22 / ROADMAP Phase 1A: every attack must define startup, active contact, recovery, range, stamina cost, guard interaction, hit reaction, counter vulnerability, and positional consequence BEFORE character-specific abilities are added.

cost_model.description: Decision 0014 (gate G1). 'displacement' means this field is a DERIVED echo of movement_model.locomotion.<mode>.stamina_cost_per_ru at full stride and the core prices the action by the distance actually travelled; the validator recomputes it and fails on drift. 'flat' means the cost is authored as written, which is permitted only for a separately named explosive action - never for an ordinary adjustment step.

target_regions.description: Required non-empty for offensive categories. Movement, guard, evasion and clinch actions may legitimately strike nothing.

tuning_status.description: Rule 18: prototype numbers are tuning hypotheses unless a validated specification or test promotes them.

allOf.$comment: An attack that hits nowhere is not an attack; a pivot that hits nowhere is a pivot.
